info.title: URL to Markdown
info.description: An Apify Actor that takes a URL as input and returns the content of the page in Markdown format.

get.description: Fetches the web page at the given URL and returns its content converted to Markdown.
get.summary: Fetches the web page at the given URL and returns its content converted to Markdown.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Enter the URL of a specific web page to extract its content in Markdown format.

parameters.name: scrapingTool
parameters.description:
Select the scraping mode for extracting the target web pages.

The Raw HTTP mode (default) is the fastest, but can't handle JavaScript.

The Browser mode is more powerful, can handle JavaScript heavy websites, but costs more.

parameters.name: proxyConfiguration
parameters.description: Apify Proxy configuration used for scraping the target web pages, as a JSON-encoded object string.
